name: 28377 · Red Springs, NC
findings: ZIP 28377 (Red Springs) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28377 (Red Springs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
80% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
